key.name: tdp-enabled
key.description: Whether the TDP limit is enabled.

key.name: tdp-limit
key.description: The limit to restore when manual TDP is switched on. Zero is always the maximum.

key.name: gpu-manual
key.description: Whether the manual GPU clock is enabled.

key.name: gpu-clock
key.description: The clock to restore when the manual GPU clock is switched on. Zero is always the maximum.
